identity.title: Make Runtime v3 Observatory local HTTPS and report bound control address

values.task_boundary: Repair only the Runtime v3 control transport and truthful discovery path.
deliverables: Actual bound-port readiness and feed data
acceptance_criteria: Production serve path has no plain-HTTP control listener
TLS certificate and private-key paths are required and validated
Local HTTPS Observatory fetch succeeds without a gateway
Ephemeral listener reports its actual port
Disallowed origins receive no CORS grant
No Runtime v3 cutover or Runtime v2 deletion claim changes
Focused tests, formatting, diff checks, and review pass
dependencies: Runtime v3 explicit opt-in control path
